answer: We present a cryptanalytic thesis on Sybil resistance via recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments, leveraging verifiable delay functions and a falcon-based verifiable random function to ensure identity uniqueness. In the meadow of information-theoretic security, we prove computational hardness of identity spoofing, rendering cloning infeasible. Our construction, akin to a comet's trajectory, achieves Byzantine fault tolerance and cryptographic finality, substantiating an unforgeable reputation framework.
